analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.49) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.26/$1.08/$1.09) — Above short-term/mid-term trends, indicating a strong position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($1.15/$1.27) — Above long-term trends, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (22.9%) + Current price level is significantly higher than historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.8→86.1) + Entered overbought territory, confirming strong upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0024→0.0545) + Continued improvement, signaling bullish trend expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (above upper band $1.37) + Bandwidth at 52.63% indicates a period of expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38) + Support level based on Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance ($1.51) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Sustained renewal of 5-day highs, reinforcing the uptrend.
